analyst_view.overall: Promoted Paderborn (14th, 9 points) have drawn 0-0 in each of their last two league games and have won both of their league games this season at home. Frankfurt (8th) beat Hamburg 3-1 last time out, but Mario Götze is out with an ear infection, and captain Robin Koch (knee) is in a race to be fit. Adi Hütter expects a grinding game against an 'unpleasant opponent'.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. Paderborn come in on two straight goalless draws and Hütter is expecting a grind. Frankfurt are also without Götze, and Burkardt and Ebnoutalib are sharing the striker role, so we expect a tight game.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. Nothing in the team news changes how either side is likely to attack wide, so we stay with the model.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.4 cards. A tight, grinding game could add a booking, but there is no specific discipline news. Bastian Dankert referees.

shots.text: The numbers say 30 shots. Paderborn's recent games have been low-event (two 0-0s), and Frankfurt are without Götze, one of their creators. We expect a bit fewer shots than the model.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. Two goalless draws in a row for Paderborn and Götze's absence for Frankfurt point to slightly fewer clear efforts.
